title: Design, Synthesis, and Anticancer Evaluation of Novel MGBs with Alkyne-Linked Thiazole Moieties.
authors: Msallam, Yousef A; Ramadan, Wafaa S; Al-Jubeh, Hadeel; Ravi, Anil; Alhamidi, Reem Sami; Yener Ilce, Burcu; Menon, Varsha; Hersi, Fatema; Altaie, Alaa; Kumar, Praveen; Malhotra, Sanjay V; Omar, Hany A; El-Awady, Raafat; Hamoudi, Rifat; Alniss, Hasan Y
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成新型小沟槽结合剂并利用分子对接和MD模拟验证其与DNA小沟槽的可逆结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（小沟槽结合剂-DNA体系）且采用物理模拟方法，但对象非TF-DNA，故评6分。
abstract: Minor groove binders (MGBs) are promising DNA-targeting agents for cancer therapy. Using a structure-based drug design approach, we developed a novel class of MGBs featuring alkyne-linked thiazole moieties to enhance DNA-binding affinity, lipophilicity, and cytotoxic efficacy. The synthesized compounds were evaluated using the NCI-60 panel and SRB assay, identifying MGB1Y, MGB2Y, and MGB6Y as potent inhibitors of cancer cell proliferation. Isothermal titration calorimetry, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed their strong and reversible binding to the DNA minor groove, particularly at the 5'-ACTAGT-3' and 5'-AGTACT-3' binding sites. Transcriptomic analysis revealed downregulation of genes involved in cell cycle progression and chromatin organization alongside upregulation of lipid metabolism genes, suggesting the disruption of lipid homeostasis. Additionally, these compounds inhibit topoisomerase I, further supporting their DNA-targeting mechanism. Their strong anticancer activity, reversible noncovalent DNA interaction, and favorable binding properties highlight their potential for further development as anticancer therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 小沟结合剂（MGBs）是癌症治疗中具有前景的DNA靶向剂。通过基于结构的药物设计方法，我们开发了一类新型MGBs，其特点是含有炔基连接的噻唑部分，以增强DNA结合亲和力、亲脂性和细胞毒性效力。合成的化合物通过NCI-60面板和SRB实验进行评估，鉴定出MGB1Y、MGB2Y和MGB6Y为癌细胞增殖的有效抑制剂。等温滴定量热法、分子对接和分子动力学模拟证实了它们与DNA小沟的强效且可逆结合，特别是在5'-ACTAGT-3'和5'-AGTACT-3'结合位点。转录组分析揭示了参与细胞周期进程和染色质组织的基因下调，同时脂质代谢基因上调，提示脂质稳态的破坏。此外，这些化合物抑制拓扑异构酶I，进一步支持其DNA靶向机制。其强效抗癌活性、可逆的非共价DNA相互作用以及有利的结合特性，突显了其作为抗癌治疗药物进一步开发的潜力。
